title: Three Shifts and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（人与社会·科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（人与社会·科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：load　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 load 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the builder ① carried the load that no worker in the site would have measured, and he said the carrying was the whole of the shift. The ② load, meaning the weight itself and not the beam, ran three shifts and stayed unmeasured in the book; a load, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ load in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ load at the far ramp, meaning the crate they kept for the children to shift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A load, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the builder said the measuring is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the load was the whole of the matter, meaning the burden and not the weight. The ⑥ load, meaning the burden and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; load, he said, is either something you carry or the only word that means both a weight and a burden. He said the burden is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ load had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ load of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three shifts of measuring; load, he said, is either the crate at the far ramp or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ load I remember is the weight measured in the sheet, which closed in 1993 and is still measured as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ load, my mother said in 1995, is the only weight that improves by being measured; every load, she said, is a burden that has agreed to look like a weight. She said the burden was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 负载；承载量（指工地里每一车旁边的那一车）
B. n. 负载；承载量（指那车重物本身，与横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：carry the load 承载这一车负载
D. n. 负载；承载量（指留给孩子们挪的那一箱那一车）
E. n. 承重之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的负载之事）
F. n. 负载；承载量（指施工记录表里写到、被测过的的那一车）
G. n. 负担、承重（指一件事里人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 承重（抽象总称，指人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: carried the load that no worker in the site would have measured
The load, meaning the weight itself and not the beam
the load at the far ramp
the load was the whole of the matter
the load had become a line in a sheet
The load of the whole thing
A load, my mother said in 1995

answers.why: carry the load 意为“承载这一车负载”，1986 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位工人肯测量的一车负载做了一遍。
load 意为“负载；承载量”，指那车重物本身而不是横梁，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被测量。
load 意为“负载；承载量”，指工地里每一车旁边的那一车，每一车旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
load 意为“负载；承载量”，指最远那道坡台留给孩子们挪的那一箱那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
load 意为“负担、承重”，指一件事里人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份承重就是那件事的全部。
load 意为“承重”，指人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西而不是那车重物，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
load 意为“负载；承载量”，指施工记录表里写到、被测过的的那一车，到 1991 年这一车成了施工记录表里的一行。
load 意为“承重之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的负载之事是一处工地和三个班次的测量。
load 意为“负载；承载量”，我记得的是施工记录表里测量过的那一车，1993 年卸完了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一车。
load 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，负载是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的重物。

items: 1986 年那位施工员承载了工地里没有一位工人肯测量的一车负载，他说这一遍才是那个班次的全部。（carry the load）
那车负载，指的是那车重物本身而不是横梁，经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被测量。（load）
那处工地里每一车负载旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。（load）
最远那道坡台那车负载，指的是他们留给孩子们挪的那一箱那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（load）
叔叔说这份承重就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那车重物。（load）
1995 年母亲说，负载是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的重物。（load）

The load at the far ramp, meaning the crate they kept for the children to shift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
